name: 46311 · Dyer, IN
findings: ZIP 46311 (Dyer) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46311 (Dyer) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46311 (Dyer) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
